scope: Jeeves commerce backend adaptation using REST/JSON rather than Vendure GraphQL: authenticated checkout, USD integer minor units, one stock location, one payment per order, flat shipping and fixture tax quote. Local reference payment provider proves protocol only; production provider is V19. At most 100 lines/order and quantity <=1000; uncertain payments hold stock for reconciliation.
excludedScope: Full upstream clone or API compatibility
Application page layout and visual UI composition
Unmeasured production capacity or provider certification
Production tax law or real payment-provider verification from the local reference provider
Promotions, production tax/shipping, returns/refunds, marketplace, currency conversion, real payments and ERP integration remain hook targets.

conditions: Proposed local engineering target; no measurement or upstream capacity claim.
Suggested reference allocation: 8 logical CPUs, 16 GiB RAM, local SSD; record actual host/container/database limits and fixture seed.
Run one and two API instances with shared authority; use open-loop offered load for 600 seconds after warm-up.
Report scheduled/achieved rate, latency including failures, error rate, queue growth, DB connections and resource use; count expected rejections separately.
Unexpected server failures target <0.1%; never lower frozen targets after a failure. Label undersized profiles separately.
Separate barrier contention: 25 attempts for one stock item, 25 stale updates at one revision, and two deadline workers claiming one batch, where applicable.
Separately labeled recovery run restarts one API and one worker and records unavailable time, backlog recovery and invariants; no infinite stress or live data.

capabilities.description: Customer/admin sessions and role separation; a customer cannot invoke catalog/admin operations or forge a shop scope
Products/variants and published catalog with bounded queries; unpublished records stay absent from public results and related assets
Fixed-price money calculation in integer minor units; immutable quote inputs, consistent currency, quantity bounds and overflow rejection
Cart add/change/remove with version checks and bounded lines; duplicate commands do not double quantity and invalid prices are ignored as authority
Checkout creates one order with line/address/price snapshot and reservations atomically; changed quote/version conflicts without partial order
Stock reservation, release and expiration; concurrent last-item checkouts cannot oversell; held payment stock is not blindly expired
Order lifecycle and cancellation guards; invalid transitions and stale actions cannot mark unpaid orders paid or shipped
Payment protocol against a local reference provider: authenticated callbacks, duplicate/out-of-order events, ambiguous timeout and reconciliation
excludedScope: Real-provider verification belongs to V19; this row verifies the local reference protocol only.

capabilities.description: Fulfillment records and partial shipment quantities; cannot ship more than paid, reserved, unfulfilled quantities; retries preserve one shipment
Published catalog search with stable paging and rebuildable projections; hidden prices/stock internals are not returned
Customer order/history visibility and staff capabilities; direct IDs, lists, downloads and callbacks respect the same ownership boundaries
Audited order/payment/fulfillment transitions and durable notifications; retries do not duplicate internal effects or expose another customer's details
Promotion eligibility and allocation; deterministic rounding order, exclusions, caps and repeated recalculation
Production tax quotation adapter/policy; immutable quote provenance and a clear outcome when the provider cannot quote
Shipping-rate and carrier selection strategy; declared package/address inputs and unavailable-provider behavior
Returns and partial-refund policy; maximum refundable quantity/amount, duplicate request and uncertain provider result
Marketplace seller attribution and settlement policy; isolate seller access and do not conflate customer payment with seller payout
Multiple currencies and conversion policy; snapshot rates/rounding and never silently reinterpret stored money
A real payment-provider adapter; map its signature, status, idempotency and reconciliation semantics to the already verified protocol
Inventory/ERP synchronization adapter; deduplicate source revisions and define conflict authority and recovery
